name: market-cheaper
hypothesis: Summer-Autumn Spends are 21-36% (P3 <= 25%) because towns cannot afford any scoring Build, and goods bought from neighbours cost 3-5 coins from Summer on. Neighbour prices 1/3/4/5 -> 1/2/3/4 make more Builds legal, so Summer-Autumn Spend shares drop under 25%. Greedy does not price purchases into its choice, but legality includes them, so this changes bot decisions.
